description: This PHP source file defines the EligibleLeaveTypeAPI class, which is a part of the Leave API in the OrangeHRM system. It provides an endpoint to retrieve the list of leave types for an employee that they are eligible for, with options to include allocated leave. The class uses traits for authentication and leave type services, and implements validation and response handling for the API.
